name: CENNETIC Z600L+ 5-Axis Drilling & Tapping Center
summary: The Z600L+ is a 5-axis drilling and tapping center that adds an RDDS200 direct-drive rotary table to a high-speed vertical platform, enabling angled hole-making and 5-sided contouring of small-to-medium parts in a single setup.
body:
The Z600L+ is a 5-axis drilling and tapping center that adds an RDDS200 direct-drive rotary table to a high-speed vertical platform, enabling angled hole-making and 5-sided contouring of small-to-medium parts in a single setup.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
